scope: Gate0 certificate/interface/offline one-initial-state optimization only; NO six closed-loop tests, no new P/Q strategy or gain/performance search
information: Initial i_alpha_beta, measured P/Q/Vdc, old applied and queued modulation, source held command and physical parameters. Recover source phase only by the measured PCC algebra, not event or future source data. Noiseless frozen-model measurements are used; no hardware sensor-accuracy claim.
normalization: Current divided by frozen phase-peak Ibase; modulation unchanged dimensionless; source-phase-aligned coordinates derived from measured initial source phasor and known60Hz contract.

broad_circle.description: Source vector may jump anywhere in disk |e|<=Vbase, including180degree reversals; deliberately broader than existing sag family

structured_amplitude.description: Balanced source, initial phase obtained causally from current electrical measurements; rotates at fixed60Hz without phase jumps; amplitude can jump at any unknown time anywhere in[.4,1.0]pu, including recovery; no event timing access

first_hold_Vdc_bound: Use current W/Pb/known held source command and locked energy/lag/ramp equations. A first-exit argument jointly bounds W and I over the immutable100us hold; no future trajectory data.
feedback_design: Let a=exp(-Rtot Ts/Ltot), b=(1-a)/Rtot, c=1400*b/Ibase and rotation Rot(-omega Ts). K=[-a^2/c I2, -a I2] is fixed closed-form deadbeat feedback. (A+BK)^2=0 analytically; not fitted to trajectories.
disturbance_design: For each declared contract, disk radius r=b*(max(|Vmin-1400|,|Vmax-1400|)*mmax + source_uncertainty_radius*Vbase)/Ibase. Queue residual is zero in the mathematical model. Conditional on Vdc domain and actual held modulation bound.
RPI_design: Omega=W Minkowski-sum (A+BK)W. W has a2D current disk radius r and zero queue component. Finite sum exact for the ideal deadbeat matrix. Report numerical nilpotence and support/invariance residuals; no random samples establish the certificate.
terminal_design: Nominal current0, held qbar chosen to exactly cancel the known center source integral over one100us hold; mbar=Rot(+omega Ts)qbar. Terminal set sbar+Omega, backup m=mbar+K(s-sbar). Check all modulation and intersample current bounds analytically. This is conditional current safety, NOT a joint DC/SoC invariant set.
intersample_design: Use exact RL hold flow and deterministic residual radius. With this deadbeat construction current-error tube radius is r*(1+a) for every hold fraction. Nominal current constraints at fixed nodes{0,25,50,75,100}us add a priori chord-error bound M2*(25us)^2/8 and numerical reserve1e-8pu. No dense-trajectory sampling is used as an invariant-set proof.
optimization_design: One initial point per contract. Variables are two2D disturbance witnesses for x0-z0 inOmega and N nominal2D modulation commands. Exact affine lifted dynamics; quadratic norm constraints for tightened current/queue/input and equality terminal zN=sbar. Minimize squared first actual modulation deviation from the original PI nominal command.

solver.library: Existing SciPy SLSQP; no new package installation
solver.initialization: Unique minimum-Euclidean-norm solution of terminal affine equality via numpy lstsq; no restarts or parameter scan
solver.interpretation: A verified feasible primal plan suffices for this one-point admission witness; solver failure is inconclusive unless an independent reachability/separation proof is given. No solver infeasibility flag is treated as physical impossibility.

first_hold_evaluation.certification: Outward physical current/Vdc bounds plus derivative padding between fixed nodes; compute explicit broad-circle180degree phase-reversal witness separately. Structured envelope cannot silently inherit that counterexample.

stopping_rule: Do not change N,K,mmax,Ilimit,Vdc limits, contracts or checkpoint after seeing results. List any proof gap, empty/unadmitted set, residual failure or missing backup. No closed-loop controller experiment is authorized by this file.
runtime: Wall time is offline diagnostic data only; no100us real-time deployment claim.
